images.title: Four steps for a puzzle
images.purpose: Shows the four step plan for every puzzle on the cows puzzle: name, equation, solve, check.
images.composition: Four boxes in a row joined by arrows, a step word above each box.
images.exact_structure: Four equal rounded boxes in one row, white fill, dark outline, joined by three arrows. Above them, one teal #0072B2 step word each: name, equation, solve, check. Inside, in order: g and 2g; 2g − 3 = g + 3; g = 6; 9 = 9. The last box has a reddish purple #CC79A7 outline. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Name it, write the equation, solve, then check in the story.
